title: Breaker box door and button controller
description: ESP32 #2: independent ultrasonic door monitoring and sustained-noise servo response.

schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "group", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cabinet_monitor" and r.location == "breaker_box", start: -1d)
list.definition:

schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "group", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cabinet_monitor" and r.location == "breaker_box", start: -1d)

list.name: device
list.label: Cabinet board
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "device", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cabinet_monitor" and r.location == "breaker_box" and r.group =~ /^${group:regex}$/, start: -1d)

schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "device", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cabinet_monitor" and r.location == "breaker_box" and r.group =~ /^${group:regex}$/, start: -1d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -15s, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cabinet_monitor" and r.location == "breaker_box")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.group =~ /^${group:regex}$/ and r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "door_state_code")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device"])
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()

panels.title: Distance and configured door threshold

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cabinet_monitor" and r.location == "breaker_box")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.group =~ /^${group:regex}$/ and r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["distance_cm", "door_threshold_cm"]))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "device"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "device"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

options.content:
Door sensing is independent of servo control. Default: **open above 20 cm**, closed at or below 18 cm after median filtering and a 600 ms stable candidate. No echo is **unknown**, never closed.

Default servo trigger: fresh microphone readings **≥90 dB for 3 seconds**, one press and return. Rearms after 3 seconds below 88 dB after return. Configure endpoints, timing and thresholds through the cabinet board’s local web page. Mic values already include its configured 15 dB reduction.

This is a bench demonstration, using an estimated noise level and a mock button. An MQTT publish confirms a command was issued; there is no button-contact feedback. Public lab broker and LAN control page are unauthenticated; they are unsuitable for controlling a real electrical breaker. Software test points are excluded.
